icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone original Windows desktop application icon for a C# educational app. The two attached images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: study their Microsoft Windows 10 / early Windows 11 Fluent app-icon language (Windows Terminal, Office, Calendar, To Do). Match simple crisp layered 2.5D vector-like forms, broad flat satin color planes, very restrained tonal gradients and tiny soft overlap shadows. Mostly frontal view, almost no perspective, sharp readable geometry with modest corner rounding. Mature practical native Windows icon, clear at 32 to 64 pixels. Absolutely no glossy glass, inflated jelly, chrome, glow, bright specular rims, heavy bevels or photorealistic 3D. Do not copy logos. The subject itself makes the silhouette, without a generic enclosing rounded app tile. Center on a square canvas with 12 percent clear margin around the whole object, actual transparent alpha background, no label, caption, watermark, floor or backdrop. A compact layered terminal app window: dark charcoal front console with a narrow neutral gray title strip, crisp white >_ prompt; one modest blue rear pane offset slightly up and right. Rectangular practical terminal silhouette inspired by the Windows Terminal icon in the reference, with original proportions. Restrained blue accent, neutral matte dark screen, no glass.
